# Super Cleaning CC

> Professional cleaning service based in North Falmouth, MA — serving all of Cape Cod since 2004.

Super Cleaning CC is a woman-owned, owner-operated cleaning business founded by Adriana in 2004. With over 20 years of experience, the company specializes in residential home cleaning, vacation rental and Airbnb turnovers, deep cleaning, boat cleaning, commercial cleaning, and seasonal opening and closing cleans across Cape Cod, Massachusetts.

## Key Facts

- **Founded:** 2004
- **Owner:** Adriana (founder and direct point of contact)
- **Based in:** North Falmouth, Massachusetts (Barnstable County)
- **Service area:** All of Cape Cod — Falmouth, Barnstable, Sandwich, Mashpee, Bourne, and surrounding towns
- **Google rating:** 4.9 stars
- **Clients:** 200+ across Cape Cod
- **Payment:** Venmo and Zelle
- **Availability:** 7 days a week, including weekends and same-day emergency service
- **Instagram:** @supercleaning.cc
- **Email:** supercleaning.cc@gmail.com

## Services

- **Residential Cleaning** — Weekly, bi-weekly, monthly, or one-time home cleaning
- **Vacation Home & Airbnb Turnover** — Guest-ready cleaning between bookings, flexible scheduling during peak season
- **Deep Cleaning** — Move-in, move-out, post-renovation, spring cleaning
- **Commercial Cleaning** — Offices, small businesses, B&Bs
- **Emergency / Same-Day Cleaning** — Last-minute availability across Cape Cod
- **Seasonal Open & Close** — Spring opening cleans and fall closing cleans for seasonal properties
- **Boat Cleaning** — Interior and exterior vessel cleaning

## About Adriana

Adriana founded Super Cleaning CC in 2004 with the goal of providing Cape Cod families with the kind of personalized, trustworthy cleaning service she would want in her own home. She is the direct point of contact for all clients — no call centers, no strangers. Many of her clients have been with her since the beginning, a testament to 20+ years of reliable service.

## Common Questions

**What areas does Super Cleaning CC serve?**
All of Cape Cod, including North Falmouth, Falmouth, Barnstable, Sandwich, Mashpee, Bourne, and all towns in Barnstable County, MA.

**How do I get a quote?**
Fill out the contact form at www.supercleaningcc.com/#contact or message @supercleaning.cc on Instagram. Adriana personally responds within a few hours.

**Do they bring their own supplies?**
Yes. Eco-friendly and fragrance-free options available on request.

**Do I need to be home?**
No. Many long-term clients provide key or entry code access.

**What payment methods are accepted?**
Venmo and Zelle.

**Do they do Airbnb turnovers?**
Yes. Coordinated around guest check-out and check-in times. Full turnover includes all rooms cleaned, linens changed, essentials restocked.
